# FreeMagic (Magic Software)

The part of Magic Software's FreeMagic library that the Actor Editor's skinned-mesh export uses: bounding spheres,
cylinders and boxes for bone shapes, with what they depend on. Copied from IX-Ray's
`src/3rd-party/MagicSoftware/FreeMagic` (commit `09c1a3de9`), unchanged. GSC's tools use the same library
(`code/utils/xrLC/mgc`, `code/utils/xrAI/mgc`).
